## `neuro.uint8Array.fromBase64`

Static method on `Uint8Array`.

> Creates a new `Uint8Array` from a base64-encoded string.

## Signatures

```ts
fromBase64(input: { string: string; options?: { alphabet?: "base64" | "base64url" | undefined; lastChunkHandling?: "loose" | "strict" | "stop-before-partial" | undefined; }; prompt?: string }): Promise<Uint8Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint8Array.fromBase64` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
